message: 宝箱

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Aren't you Ria-senpai and Misasagi-senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「Hello, Synn-kun.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Good day, and much obliged. A fine day to you, President.」

name: Synn
message: 「M-Much obliged...? Misasagi-senpai, you seem pretty happy?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah, Ayaka-chan is delighted. She suddenly said she wanted to see Grand Palace Sakura.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I simply grew curious as to what sort of place Lia's successor resides in.」

name: Ria
message: 「Right now, you can move in immediately with zero agency fees, zero key money, and just one month's deposit!」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Senpai, you really don't need to pitch it like that.」

name: Ria
message: 「Well, if Ayaka-chan lives here, I feel like I'll get more chances to see you, Synn-kun.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeehaw! In that case, black tights are more than welcome!」

name: Synn
message: 「M-Misasagi-senpai, are you seriously thinking of living here?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Well now, I wonder? Might you allow me a viewing? I did take a look at the garden a moment ago, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't mind at all, but--」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah! If you went into the vegetable patch, Sasami must have attacked you, right? Are you hurt?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Sasami? Ah, you mean that chicken.」

name: Sasami
message: 「Bawk?! Bock-bock-bawk!」

name: Paqy
message: 「That bastard Sasami is terrified...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「The fellow challenged me to a staring contest, so I merely offered a little greeting.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I see... I'm just glad neither of you got hurt.」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun, why don't you show her inside then?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「You look awfully happy, Lia.」

name: Ria
message: 「Going into Synn-kun's home always gets me excited.」

name: Synn
message: 「Right this way, both of you.」

name: Synn
message: 「--And that's pretty much how it is.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「It's cedar, isn't it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「The ceiling boards. A very skilled carpenter must have built this place.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that so?」

name: Ria
message: 「S-Synn-kun, you didn't notice?」

name: Synn
message: 「Originally, this apartment belonged to a friend of my dad's, and the Sakura family bought it from him. So I don't really know any of the details about the building...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Perhaps the very fact that you live here so naturally, President, is what gives it such a wonderful atmosphere.」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Umm, it's hard for me to really feel it...」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, we shouldn't just stand around talking, so please have a seat. I'll go make some tea right now.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah, please don't trouble yourself.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Are you sure about that, Synn-sama? All you've got here are spent tea leaves, right? Big-hearted Ria-chan aside, we've got Black Tights with us today, ya know?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I would certainly like Ria to have something nice to drink. President, may I borrow your kitchen? I shall brew the tea today.」
And then everyone relaxed together.

name: Ria
message: 「Gulp, phew... As always, Ayanishiki-chan's tea is delicious.」

name: Synn
message: 「It really is, it's great!」

name: Paqy
message: 「I-I can't believe it...! Brewing spent tea leaves this wonderfully...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「You needn't praise me so much. Well, putting that aside, to continue what we were talking about earlier...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Here, all the main parts like the pillars and latticework are made of oak. And the built-in furnishings, such as the closet and kitchen, are made of cypress.」

name: Synn
message: 「They are?」

name: Paqy
message: 「You don't understand their value at all, do you, Synn-sama?」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun, see how the wood grain on the ceiling boards alternates vertically and horizontally? Plus, the nageshi lintels in this room are two-tiered.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「It has elements akin to the formal 'shin' style. This is the work of a craftsman who deeply understands Japanese-style rooms.」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Sorry, hearing all this out of nowhere doesn't really ring a bell.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Lord Synn, you see how there's barely any seams in the floorboards? You can't get single-plank wood like this nowadays, ya know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You're overestimating it. There's no way Grand Palace Sakura is anything that amazing.」

name: Synn
message: 「In fact, the windows in this room are cheap junk that warp the view, and even the mirror in the kitchen has a yellowed reflection.」

name: Ria
message: 「No, wavy windows are a characteristic of Taisho-era glass, you know? Just like Pa-chan said, they're precious antiques that aren't made anymore.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「The mirror's from around that time too, ya know. The reason it gives off that soft, yellowish reflection is 'cause of the old silver plating.」

name: Synn
message: 「S-S-S-S-Silverrrr?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Gurgle, gurgle, gurgle...」

name: Ria
message: 「Kyaa?! Hang in there, Synn-kun」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Oh dear, he went and fainted.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Passing out just to get a lap pillow from Ria-chan--what a terrifyingly divine calculation. Just what I'd expect from Lord Synn.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「The Prez sure is a natural airhead. It's enough to make a girl jealous.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahaha... Let's just take it easy here until Synn-kun wakes up, Ayanishiki-chan.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Well then, shall I go brew us another pot of tea?」

name: Ria
message: 「Rather than that, I'd love to have a nice chat with you, Ayanishiki-chan♪」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I feel the exact same way, Liia.」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah... So, what are you going to do? Are you really moving into Synn-kun's place? You still have time.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「It's a shame, really, but we came to look at it a year too late.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Liia, this apartment is a treasure chest. It's no place for the likes of us who're graduating next year.」

name: Ria
message: 「A treasure chest, huh... You really have a way with words.」

name: Synn
message: 「Mmph, mmph, so many elephants...」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh my, I wonder what kind of dream you're having, Synn-kun.」

name: Paqy
message: 「At this rate, by the time he wakes up, he's gonna have completely forgotten all about Ria-chan and Lady Black-Tights's little lecture.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Well, that's fine in its own right.」

name: Ria
message: 「That's right, Pah-chan. Don't hold back--the house comes alive way more when you use it freely as you please, okay?\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「Mmh, mmh...」
For some reason, I seem to have fallen asleep right in the middle of showing her around the room.
When I woke up, Misasagi-senpai politely turned me down, saying she had no intention of signing a lease.
It's a little lonely, but it was the answer I expected.
As usual, the residents here are just me, Paqy, Sally-chan, and Sasami, though that's easygoing in its own right.
